About me

I’m Durrani Hakim, an Electrical Engineering student majoring in Power Systems, and I’ll be ready to take on full-time work starting January 2026. My studies have equipped me with strong technical skills in electrical machine design, power electronics, and power systems. I’m particularly passionate about renewable energy and its integration into modern grids. I’ve been deepening my knowledge in solar PV system design and wind energy, and I’m currently self-learning tools like PVsyst and DIgSILENT PowerFactory to further enhance my skills.

Along with my academic background, I have hands-on experience with MATLAB and Python for simulation and data analysis. I’m excited about contributing to sustainable, innovative energy solutions. If you’re looking for someone in renewable energy or power systems, I would love to be part of your team!

This is me in Berlin! I had the opportunity to do an internship here in Karlsruhe, Germany a while back. It was an incredible experience that gave me the chance to learn and grow in a global environment, and I’m thankful for the opportunity to apply what I’d learned.

A proud moment after our first successful electrolyzer run! Huge thanks to Prof. Dr.-Ing. Maurice Kettner and Mr. Florian Beerlage for their incredible support and supervision during the project.
